exceptions.reason: the cancel branch of the hold demo copies the entrance law's two lines for the same reason as ArriveStatus. Fixed by the same lift. Zero pixel change.

fx/explosion.doc: Explosion — the token loads, clumps, and blows apart; major or minor.

fx/explosion|major_explosion.doc: Explosion — the token loads, clumps, and blows apart; major or minor.

fx/explosion|minor_explosion.doc: Explosion — the token loads, clumps, and blows apart; major or minor.

idle/batch_sign.doc: Batch sign — the teal token drifts on the idle sweep, trail following.

idle/unknown_token.doc: Token idle — a solid token drifts on the idle sweep, its ramp trailing.

pin/check_word.doc: Check word — pick the backup word asked for, out of nine.

pin/pin_differ.doc: Duress PIN differ — the pin-category name for the duress_differ film.

pin/pin_entering.doc: PIN entering — the eight-ring input, typed with the two buttons.

verdict/duress_differ.doc: Duress PIN must differ — the pill is scanned, the rule refuses it.

verdict/factory_signing.doc: Factory signing — the white signing-machine gear coasts to a stop.

verdict/firmware_verified.doc: Firmware verified — a white disc arrives carrying a black check.

verdict/headshake.doc: Headshake — the X ring arrives and shakes its head once: no.

verdict/headshake|canceled.doc: Headshake — the X ring arrives and shakes its head once: no.

verdict/headshake|wrong_seed_phrase.doc: Headshake — the X ring arrives and shakes its head once: no.

verdict/last_attempt.doc: Last attempt — the attempt counter reels down to 1 beside a red heart.

exceptions.reason: LAST ATTEMPT is not a sign at all: a display digit beside a heart, composed as a PAIR on the type tier and centred by their box. The digit carries most of the ink, so the mass leans ~5 px toward it. Composed the way the type tier composes (owner decision).

verdict/padlock.doc: Padlock — the shackle turns in and clicks shut, or springs open.

verdict/padlock|lock.doc: Padlock — the shackle turns in and clicks shut, or springs open.

verdict/padlock|unlock.doc: Padlock — the shackle turns in and clicks shut, or springs open.

exceptions.reason: the unlock preset RESTS OPEN — the shackle has sprung up and clear of the body, so the open pose's mass sits right of and above the circle. The CLOSED rest, which the bare padlock and its lock preset show, is what the centre law governs, and it passes.

verdict/pin_mismatch.doc: PIN mismatch — the entered PIN fills the pill, turns red, is shaken off.

verdict/pin_mismatch|wrong_pin.doc: PIN mismatch — the entered PIN fills the pill, turns red, is shaken off.

verdict/rng_failed.doc: RNG failed — the red die rests, tumbles on three axes and lands on 1-2-3.

verdict/shield.doc: Shield — the backup shield arrives with its mark and nods yes, or shakes no.

exceptions.reason: both sources sit the mark about 2 px above the shield's centre, and the shield keeps its OUTLINE — it is the container, the mark inside it is the verdict (the one written exception to the filled-silhouette rule, owner decision, Sep 2026). Centring the mass would drop the mark onto the shield's lower lobe, where the outline narrows.

verdict/shield|backup_ok.doc: Shield — the backup shield arrives with its mark and nods yes, or shakes no.

verdict/shield|no_match.doc: Shield — the backup shield arrives with its mark and nods yes, or shakes no.

exceptions.reason: the same shield carrying the X instead of the check — the same 2 px, same reason.

verdict/sig_error.doc: Sig error — the warning triangle reports a failed check, detail-grid.

exceptions.reason: the same notice triangle, docked in a detail column instead of centred — it is measured against its own column centre and reads identically to tamper's (ICO-06 closed the gap between them). Box-centred by the same decision.

verdict/sig_error|sig_verify_fail.doc: Sig error — the warning triangle reports a failed check, detail-grid.

verdict/sig_error|type1_sig_fail.doc: Sig error — the warning triangle reports a failed check, detail-grid.

exceptions.reason: sig_error's own docked triangle with other lines (TYPE 1 SIG) — the anim:verdict/sig_error row's decision, not a new exception: box-centred, never nudged.

verdict/slot_registered.doc: Slot registered — a white disc arrives carrying the black rotate mark.

verdict/tamper.doc: Tamper detected — the warning triangle's exclamation, centred, sounds the alarm.

exceptions.reason: the notice triangle is BOX-centred: its bounding box sits on the circle, and two thirds of a triangle's area lies in its lower half, so the mass measures ~10 px low. Centring the mass instead would float the apex above the grid every other sign sits on, and the three notices would stop lining up with each other.

verdict/tamper|firmware_tampered.doc: Tamper detected — the warning triangle's exclamation, centred, sounds the alarm.

exceptions.reason: tamper's own triangle under a second caption (FIRMWARE TAMPERED) — the anim:verdict/tamper row's decision, not a new exception: box-centred, never nudged.

verdict/wipe.doc: Wallet wiped — the warning triangle carries the brush.

exceptions.reason: WALLET WIPED's triangle, box-centred like tamper's; it sits a touch higher because the wipe mark inside it carries ink the exclamation does not.

verdict/wipe|wallet_wiped_anim.doc: Wallet wiped — the warning triangle carries the brush.

verdict/wipe|wallet_wiped_explosion.doc: Wallet wiped — the warning triangle carries the brush.

exceptions.reason: the same triangle led by the explosion film; the blast is long gone by the resting frame, so what is measured is wipe's pose.

note: phases are per INSTANCE (they change per preset). duration = t_resolve + result_hold. All ms.
